# Contract: lane work tip

## Ref

- **Name:** `refs/spec-kitty/lane-tip/<full-lane-branch-name>`
- **Scope:** local only; never pushed.

## Recorder hook

The hook is `post-commit`, written in POSIX `sh`, and installed at `git rev-parse --git-path hooks` by `policy/hook_installer.py`.

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Generated by spec-kitty (lane-tip recorder). Do not edit by hand.
b=$(git symbolic-ref -q HEAD) || exit 0
case "$b" in refs/heads/kitty/mission-*-lane-*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
id=${b##*-lane-}
case "$id" in ''|*[!a-z]*) exit 0 ;; esac
git update-ref "refs/spec-kitty/lane-tip/${b#refs/heads/}" HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1
exit 0
```

Rules:

- The hook is installed only if the slot is empty or already carries the spec-kitty signature. Otherwise the installer warns and leaves the slot alone (C-010).
- It always exits 0 and never starts Python (NFR-001).

## API (`specify_cli.lanes.lane_tip`)

| Function | Returns / effect |
|---|---|
| `tip_ref(branch) -> str` | the ref name for the lane branch |
| `record_tip(repo_root, branch, sha=None) -> str \| None` | writes the ref, using HEAD of `branch` when `sha` is `None`; returns `None` if the branch is missing |
| `read_tip(repo_root, branch) -> str \| None` | the recorded SHA, or `None` |
| `clear_tip(repo_root, branch) -> None` | deletes the ref |
| `is_absorbed(repo_root, tip, target, base) -> bool` | raises `AbsorptionUnsupported` when git is too old to evaluate |

`is_absorbed` returns `True` in any of three cases:

- `tip == base`
- `tip` is an ancestor of `target`
- `merge-tree --write-tree target tip` equals `target^{tree}`

## Errors

| Error | Code | When | Carries |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DestroyedLaneError` | `DESTROYED_LANE` (existing) | a destroyed lane whose tip is not absorbed | `tip_sha` and a remedy `git branch <b> refs/spec-kitty/lane-tip/<b>` (restore), or `git update-ref -d refs/spec-kitty/lane-tip/<b>` (deliberately abandon) |
| `LaneWorkTipUnknownError` | `LANE_WORK_TIP_UNKNOWN` | the context is present but no tip ref exists | — |
